item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Durable Task SDK for Go
item.description:
The Durable Task SDK for Go is now in public preview. It lets developers write orchestrations, activities, and durable entities in Go, with Durable Task Scheduler handling execution history and work dispatch.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Durable Task extension for Microsoft Agent Framework
item.description:
The Durable Task extension for Microsoft Agent Framework is now generally available for C# and Python. It supports agents, multi-agent orchestrations, and workflows that can run reliably for minutes, days, or weeks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: dotnet: Durable Task in the Real World: What Problems Does It Actually Solve?
item.description:
The post outlines practical cases where durable execution is useful, where it is unnecessary, and how it relates to AI agents. It frames Durable Task as a tool for workflows that need reliable state, retries, and long-running coordination.

  • Source: .NET
